subject: Recap + quick ask: discovery notes and next step
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Ross <evelyn.ross@novaplatform.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap: quick discovery — workload, SLOs, next steps

Evelyn — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our 30‑minute discovery and a proposal for next steps so we stay aligned.

What you told us
- Workload: multi-tenant analytics pipelines that generate natural-language summaries and customer-facing insights (latency target: p95 < 350ms for API calls).
- Volume: steady baseline ~120k tokens/day with spikes during monthly reports (~3x).
- Constraints: data residency (US), integration with customer identity for audit trails, and predictable cost for exec sign-off.

How Redwood maps to that
- Routing & SLA: we can serve from our US region with dedicated capacity to meet p95 targets and offer multi-tier fallbacks.
- Cost control: caching + batching recommendations and a quantized model profile we expect will reduce per-token spend versus baseline.
- Compliance: VPC/private deployment and KMS integrations for audit requirements.

Suggested next step (pick one)
1) 20‑minute architecture alignment with your infra lead + Rishi — discuss private vs. dedicated and quick integration checklist.
2) 2‑week sandbox (hosted) with a sample dataset and our pre-built prefix caching to show latency/cost impact.

Attachments: discovery notes (PDF) with call highlights and initial config ideas.

Can you tell me which option you prefer and a couple of times that work? If this is not a priority right now, a one-line update on timing helps us not bug you.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachment: 20261101-discovery-notes.pdf (summary of call, redwood config suggestions)

Date: 2026-11-05T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: Checking in — choice on next step?

Hi Evelyn — bumping this in case it slipped through.

Quick choices again: 20‑minute architecture alignment or a short sandbox. Either is low effort on your side and should make it easier for procurement to evaluate.

If you'd prefer, tell me one thing you need from us (e.g., an ROI one‑pager, SOC2 evidence, or a narrow POC scope) and I’ll prioritize that.

Thanks — no rush; want to make sure we respect your timing.

— Jonas

Jonas — thanks for the follow up and for the notes. We had a good internal sync; two quick updates:

1) Timing: procurement cycle for AI infrastructure just pushed to Q1 2027. That means we can't commit to sandbox work this quarter.
2) Ask: if you can send a one‑page ROI summary (expected token cost delta vs. current setup, and a simple TCO model for hosted vs. dedicated), that would be helpful for our finance team.

If you can get that over, I’ll keep you in the loop and we can schedule a short alignment in Jan.

Appreciate the patience — Evelyn
Evelyn Ross

evelyn.ross@novaplatform.com | (617) 555-3310

Thanks Evelyn — noted on Q1 timing and appreciate the clarity. I’ve attached a one‑page ROI brief that compares an expected per‑token spend trajectory for your reported profile plus a short TCO table for hosted vs. dedicated capacity.

We can also:
- Hold a 15‑minute finance walkthrough (I’ll bring Rishi and a solutions engineer) to go line‑by‑line on assumptions.
- Keep the sandbox offer open — if something changes before Q1 we’ll spin it up quickly.

Proposed times for a quick walkthrough next week (15 minutes):
- Wed 11/12 11:00–11:15 ET
- Thu 11/13 16:00–16:15 ET

If those don’t work, give a range and we’ll adapt.
